newsitem.title: GERMANY: German IBIS DAX ends sluggish day slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: German IBIS DAX ends sluggish day slightly higher.

text.p: 1613 GMT - Dealers say volumes in electronic trade were hit by the pre-Lent half-day holiday in Frankfurt and IBIS DAX ends the day only slightly higher despite support from the dollar, strong at 1.67 marks, a firm opening on Wall Street and positive German debt.
* IBIS DAX index ends at 3,191.45 points, up 5.73, having earlier reached all-time high of 3,197.88 points, just shy of psychologically-important 3,200-point level.
* March DAX DTB future at 3,204.5 points, up 11.5.
* Schering volatile but ultimately ends higher after better-than-expected 1996 figures.
